# Okleevo — All-in-One Virtual HQ & Business Operating Platform

> The unified operating system for modern SMEs and growing businesses. Replace fragmented subscriptions (Slack, Zoom, Calendly, Trello, DocuSign) with one seamlessly integrated Virtual HQ.

## Overview
- **Name:** Okleevo
- **Category:** Business Operating System (BOS) & Virtual HQ Software
- **Target Audience:** Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises (SMEs), Consulting Agencies, Professional Services, Remote & Hybrid Teams
- **Website:** https://okleevo.com
- **Support Contact:** support@okleevo.com
- **Pricing:** $39.00 USD / month (Includes 5 Team Seats and full access to all modules)

## Core Platform Pillars & Capabilities

### 1. Virtual HQ & Real-Time Team Collaboration
- **Collaboration Hub:** Instant WebRTC audio/video meetings, multi-channel team chat, direct messaging, screen sharing, and live presence.
- **Mail Engine:** Centralized transactional email dispatch and automated client communications.

### 2. Async Productivity & Work Management
- **Tasks & Agile Boards:** Kanban boards, task lists, subtask breakdowns, deadlines, and team assignments.
- **Projects & Milestones:** Project roadmaps, deliverable tracking, and progress metrics.
- **Notes & Brainstorming:** Rich-text document editor with AI summaries and team documentation.
- **KPI Dashboard:** Executive business analytics, revenue telemetry, and team productivity charts.

### 3. Client Engagement & Business Operations
- **CRM Pipeline:** Visual deal pipeline, contact management, deal stages, and lead conversion tracking.
- **Booking Pages:** Shareable client meeting links, custom availability rules, automated calendar syncing.
- **E-Signatures:** Legally compliant digital document signing (eIDAS standard), signature pad, and document audit trails.
- **Email Campaigns:** Broadcast marketing campaigns, open rate tracking, and client engagement analytics.

## Security & Reliability
- **Authentication:** NextAuth.js multi-tenant authentication with Email OTP Two-Factor Authentication (2FA).
- **Multi-Tenancy:** Strict business-level data isolation via PostgreSQL and Prisma ORM.
- **Compliance:** UK VAT / HMRC compliant bookkeeping integration and encrypted data storage.
- **Payment Processing:** Integrated with Stripe for automated subscription management and customer portals.
